data.name: Nazia
data.gender_notes: Nazia is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ن-ز-ع (n-z-ʿ); the name is common in South Asia. Its root is ن-ز-ع (n-z-ʿ). A common South Asian Muslim female name. Nazia is a Arabic name meaning “Pride; (also) a sweet dish”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nazia expresses “Pride; (also) a sweet dish”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ن-ز-ع (n-z-ʿ); the name is common in South Asia.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazia total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
